text.description: Markdown; at most limits.max_text_bytes bytes of UTF-8.

expect_latest_message_id.description: Guarded reply: commit only if this is still the thread's latest message, else 409 newer_message.

labels.description: Label keys are case-insensitive on input and normalized to lowercase; the 'yak.' prefix is reserved.

mentions.description: Explicit actor IDs to mention; each must be an enabled actor who can read the channel. @handles in text are also resolved.
